title: Enrichment Cache
description: A cache of AI parser requests and their structured JSON outputs.

request_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the (chunk_hash + parser_type) to uniquely identify the request.

parser_type.description: The type of parser used for the enrichment.

chunk_hash.description: The hash of the content of the chunk that was parsed.

result.description: The structured JSON output from the AI parser.
